Streaming chat completion via Azure OpenAI — verifies the azure/ prefix routes correctly and SSE chunks are delivered in the standard OpenAI chat.completion.chunk shape

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count to 3', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'azure/gpt-4', stream: true, temperature: 0)).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
